name: Ragefire Chasm: the Blood Filled Orb summons Zelemar the Wrathful for everybody (#11770)
contract: On Ascension the Blood Filled Orb 182024 beside Jergosh could be clicked without a quest. Zelemar the Wrathful
17830 appears, shouts 'Who dare summon me!', cannot be attacked for three seconds and then attacks the player at

the orb. Here the orb kept the quest lock of 9692 (Data1 and the interaction-condition flag), so nobody could use it. The server does not check that lock; the client does, so the scenario checks what the client gets.

steps.label: CONTROL: the orb stands beside the hero
DISCRIMINATING: the client may use the orb (no interaction-condition flag 4)
DISCRIMINATING: the orb requires no quest (it required 9692)
DISCRIMINATING: using the orb without the quest summons Zelemar
He cannot be attacked right after he appears
Three seconds later he attacks the hero
